Attached: 1 video

Bayforge 0.29.12. is out! It's a free browser app I made that lays out a 3D-printable 10" or 19" rack (or a tower) for Raspberry Pis and exports plates ready to slice. Several QOL upgrades in the latest release, including no-unplug removable rear-hood, fan pins to replace screw and nut fasteners, and more. Check it out!

https://bayforge.app

#RaspberryPi #3DPrinting #homelab #selfhosted #minilab
